facts.meaning: All4 Shadow item records and every33 explicit property are preserved in complete_literal_files. Scents Joy/Excite/Vivid cost600/800/1200, sell300/400/600; TimeFlute0/sell0. All Pocket1/FieldUse OnPokemon compiles Integer1. Scents BattleUse compiles1; omitted TimeFlute BattleUse defaults0. All omit flags/BPprice/consumable/showquantity/move: flags[],BPprice1,move nil; important? false for emptyflags and field_use1, so consumabletrue,can_hold true,show_quantity? true despite raw show_quantity nil. TimeFlute portion fields nil; other3 explicit singular/plural preserved. All names/descriptions are literal localization keys, not executable effect implementations.
facts.control: Generic basename derives suffix shadow_pkmn for these items, not backup directory generation. Four unique IDs do not prove use handlers or actual source data already loaded. Source FieldUse token and compiled Integer1 are distinct representations.
facts.failure_prefix: Generic clear/register/message bucket saves followF04; invalid schema/reference/read/write may stop after earlier records or message buckets. No target item use or native save occurs during this review.
facts.open: Actual ItemHandlers scent/flute effects, all PBS default items and runtime registry activation remain independently scoped.

facts.meaning: All18 Shadow moves/every176 explicit field are preserved, including exact text/category/type/target/function/flag ordering. Every move explicitly TotalPP0, retained because source0 is truthy and schema unsigned permits0; omitted PP would default5. Physical category0 occurs Break/Rush/Blitz; other eight damaging moves Special1; seven status category2 omitPower and default0. Priority omitted→0 for all. Bolt/Chill/Fire EffectChance10; other15 omitted→0. Every type SHADOW, suffix shadow_pkmn. Target/function text controls separate downstream registry/Move-class dispatch and is not proved by prose description.
facts.control: Move validator rejects Status+nonzero power; converts damaging+zero power toStatus with diagnostic before register. These fixed18 satisfy category/power relation. End120accuracy60; Storm95; Blast80; Bolt/Break/Chill/Fire75; Rave70; Rush55; Wave50; Blitz40; Panicaccuracy90; End60/Panic90 and remaining16 at100; the complete18 records carry every exact value.
facts.failure_prefix: Per-record validation precedes duplicate check/register. Earlier registered moves persist on later failure; final Name thenDescription message hashes precede data save, not atomic.
facts.open: SHADOW Type/Target registry existence, all underlying battle function classes and native PP/display/item effects require named consumers. No complete battle-effect acceptance from literal text.

facts.meaning: All131 ShadowPokemon records/every262 fields are preserved with every GaugeSize and ordered Moves. Each section is baseSpecies/form0, noFlags=>[], suffix empty; every GaugeSize is explicit so4000 fallback is not activated for omitted field in these records. Ordered1..4 move lists retain original allocation; magnitude1500 through20000 is data, not a new range validation promise. get_species_form tries SPECIES_form first and falls back to baseSpecies when absent; unknown returnsnil. Missing entire record still lets Pokemon.max_gauge_size return4000 and makeShadow can use available SHADOWRUSH fallback.
facts.control: Schema Species enum/optional form tuple is normalized to species/form and generatedID before register. Optional Shadow loader invokes originalload only if Data/shadow_pokemon.dat exists. An absent optional input set returns before generic clear; an existing but invalid file does not receive the same no-op guarantee.
facts.failure_prefix: Lookup validation can raise before fallback on invalid argument types. Generic register/clear and file-save failure prefixes remainF04; no whole source rejection/host load proof is inferred.
facts.open: Complete Species/Move reference records and native loaded graph compatibility remain separate. No guarantee every base/form has a Shadow record.

facts.meaning: Generic4–68 checks OPTIONAL/existing paths before clear; then clearregistry, parses sections in supplied path order, validates, duplicatechecks, registers each, final-validates all and game_data.save. Name/Description producers for Move and all five Item message buckets happen in final validation before registry save. Shadow per-record validate splits tuple species/form, no extra final validation. These nested backup files are concrete author inputs only when explicitly selected/provided as compile paths, not auto enabled by mechanics generation merely because bytes exist.
facts.control: Explicit file suffix derives basename after baseName+underscore; items_shadow_pkmn/moves_shadow_pkmn=>shadow_pkmn,shadow_pokemon=>empty. Optional check succeeds when any path exists, then iteration still visits all supplied paths and may fail on another missing one. No multi-file all-or-nothing guarantee.
facts.failure_prefix: Clear and earlier registrations survive later parse/duplicate/callback failure; partial message bucket updates can survive later bucket/save failure. Direct save writes use already separately audited GameData/save helpers; no rollback or successful native archive creation was run.
facts.open: Startup complete compile selector/caches and all default/backup combinations remain bounded by independently received full source facts, not file-location assumptions.

facts.meaning: RegionalDex raw212L contains sections0 with151 species and1 with256, complete order/token/line bindings in complete_regional_dex_lists. Each list has no duplicate original token. NIDORANfE/NIDORANmA spellings are deliberately preserved; parseSpecies uppercases/trims then maps uppercaseNIDORANFE/MA back to those mixedcase IDs before registrylookup, returning actual record.id or raising undefined species. Section1 deliberately includes later evolutions YANMEGA/AMBIPOM/LICKILICKY/TANGROWTH/MAMOSWINE beyond classic251; no automatic national-order rewrite.
facts.control: compile_regional_dexes localdex_lists rejects duplicate section on encounter; prep-lines are split on commas and empty tokens skipped, with parseSpecies pertoken. Final duplicate-per-list check precedes single save_data regional_dexes.dat. Zero section index is a valid truthy source value; no header-false shortcut. A gap can leave nil list and fail list.uniq rather than implicitly filled[].
facts.failure_prefix: Parse/duplicate failure leaves old saved file because final save not reached; save itself may leave write prefix as separately audited. Compiler does not clear GameTemp regional cache within this method. No current registries were actually loaded/executed.
facts.open: Complete actual Species identity membership/consumer DexUI/Player indexing and native save behavior require their named contributions. No reference membership granted from token count alone.

facts.meaning: pbLoadRegionalDexes ensures GameTemp object then loads Data/regional_dexes.dat only when cached field false/nil, returning cached object unchanged. pbClearData clears regional/animation/move2anim/mapinfo caches before MapFactoryHelper.clear, encounter setup and conditional tileset reload. Thus a successful direct regional compile may coexist with old cached data until a real clear/newtemp path. Cache shape/inner values are not revalidated by getter.
facts.control: Empty array is truthy and remains cached. A load failure does not assign newly returned data. A clear followed by later error can leave some caches nil with other consumers only partly refreshed.
facts.failure_prefix: GameTemp creation can commit before load failure. Four nil writes precede map clear/encounter setup/tilesets; no all-cache rollback.
facts.open: All clear callers, map-factory caches and UI/index consumers remain independently scoped; this package does not approve whole compiler or caching domain.

facts.meaning: Pokemon.makeShadow writes shadowtrue/hyperfalse/savedExp0/savedEV all mainstats0, gauge from resolved record/default, stepcounter0 and shadow_moves[] before reading data. It retains only existing Move IDs from configured ordered list until MAX_MOVES; if none, available SHADOWRUSH fallback. Existing original move IDs are stored at MAX_MOVES+i, then update_shadow_moves. Update creates shadow-first list plus stage-dependent original count[3,3,2,1,1,0], skipping originals whose corresponding slots were replaced; replace_moves removes absent IDs before learning missing valid ones up toMAX_MOVES. No data record means fallback, not refusing to makeShadow.
facts.control: shadowPokemon? requires shadow flag plus nonnil gauge>=0. heartStage uses ceil(min(gauge,max)/(max/5.0)); native division/invalid zero-gauge plugin values not normalized. Nonshadow restoration relearns original suffix then sets shadow_movesnil only after replace succeeds. makeShadow does not itself invoke a save.
facts.failure_prefix: Shadow state and savedEV may partly commit before gauge/move lookup failure. replace_moves deletes/compacts before later learning calls; failure retains destructive prefix. No rollback/guaranteed native persistence.
facts.open: Complete learn_move/Pokemon::Move construction, ability/stat callbacks, full purification/battle/AI and inner serialized compatibility remain independent. Parent Pokemon_ShadowPokemon source only actually read1–191, not FULL.
